Built with Node 22.23.5 (mise.toml) and npm ci --ignore-scripts (no Electron download). better-sqlite3 uses its bundled N-API prebuild. Backend built with `npm run build`, frontend with `npm run build:frontend` (NEXT_BUILD_MODE=desktop static export). start.sh copies the seeded DB snapshot (.ui-capture/data/flo.db) into .ui-capture/runtime and then runs dev-server.js. Seed: `node .ui-capture/seed/seed.cjs` (about 10s). Store: 'Juniper & Rye Coffee House', 2217 SE Division St, Portland OR (no sales tax in Oregon, so taxes are off). Orders: about 975 completed (card and cash), 25 cancelled with reasons, and today's open orders (ready, preparing, pending) for the POS, Orders and KDS screens. Staff PIN logins: Dana Whitfield (manager) 2604, Marco Delgado (cashier) 1357, Sam Abernathy (chef) 9021; staff password Juniper#Staff26. Main areas: POS (/pos), Dashboard/reports (/dashboard), Orders (/orders), KDS (reach it through in-app navigation: a direct GET of /kds/ on the main port returns 404 because the backend reserves /kds for its WebSocket), Tables floor plan (/tables), Products, Add-on groups, Inventory (supplies/recipes), Customers, Staff, Expenses, Settings.
